title: RFID Wristband Factory — Custom Event & Hotel Wristbands | Proud Tek
summary: Direct from our Shenzhen factory: custom RFID wristbands for music festivals, conferences, hotels, water parks, and access control. Silicone, fabric, Tyvek, and PVC options with NFC and UHF chip families. MOQ 1,000 pcs, custom branding included.
heroPoints: Multiple materials: silicone, woven fabric, Tyvek, PVC, coconut shell — all with embedded RFID chips.
Event-proven at 50K-500K volume runs with 2-3 week turnaround including custom artwork.
Cashless payment integration — NFC wristbands link to event POS for contactless spending.
imageAlt: Custom RFID wristbands for events, hotels, and access control

sections.title: Why event organizers choose Proud Tek wristbands
bullets: End-to-end service — from chip selection and artwork design to encoding, numbering, and packaging by zone or gate.
Tested reliability — every wristband batch is tested for read range (3-10cm NFC, 1-8m UHF), water resistance, and clasp security.
Fast turnaround — 2-3 weeks for 50K custom wristbands including printing and encoding.
Reorder simplicity — we keep your artwork and specs on file for repeat orders with zero setup time.

faq.question: Can wristbands support cashless payment at events?
faq.answer: Yes. NFC wristbands (MIFARE Ultralight, NTAG213) integrate with most event POS systems for contactless top-up and spending. We can pre-encode wristbands with your vendor's required data format.

faq.question: What is the fastest turnaround for a large event order?
faq.answer: For orders up to 50,000 pieces, we can deliver in 2-3 weeks including custom printing and encoding. Rush orders for simpler designs can ship in 10 working days.
